name: Eduard Wernicke
original_name: エドゥアルト・ウェルニッケ
source:
Kia's target.

A student at a religious school, Eduard has pledged his life to God. He is a stoic, straightforward young man, who often thinks too deeply about things. He often suffers from feelings of self-loathing.

[From in-game profile]
